description: This file defines the UsersController class, which handles user registration, login, and user retrieval in an ASP.NET Core Web API project. It includes actions for registering a new user, logging in, and fetching user details by ID, utilizing dependency injection for the IUserService.

classes.name: UsersController
classes.description: Controller responsible for user registration, login, and retrieval operations in the delivery backend API.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Handles user registration by accepting registration details, validating the model, creating the user via the service, and returning the created user profile.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: Handles user authentication by validating credentials and returning user info if valid.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves user details based on user ID.
